description: This file defines interfaces for a basic periodic timer mechanism including function prototypes for initializing, destroying, adding, removing, reloading timers, and executing timer callbacks. It also provides a callback type definition and a private function to access the internal timer vector.

methods.name: SYNC_TIMER_Destroy
methods.description: Destroys or cleans up the timer system.

methods.name: SYNC_TIMER_Add
methods.description: Adds a new timer with a callback, identifier, and callback time.

methods.name: SYNC_TIMER_Reload
methods.description: Reloads an existing timer with a new callback time.

methods.name: SYNC_TIMER_Remove
methods.description: Removes a timer based on callback and identifier.

methods.name: SYNC_TIMER_TimeToNext
methods.description: Returns the time until the next scheduled timer event.

methods.name: SYNC_TIMER_PRIV_GetVector
methods.description: Provides access to the internal timer vector.
